name: Boombox
desc: Giant sticker-bombed ghetto blaster whose twin woofer cones pump on the bass, EQ bars dance to the spectrum and cassette reels spin — die-cut vinyl decals plastered over the shell.

energy.doc: cone pump + box rock amplitude + glow

style.doc: aesthetic: sticker-bomb collage / brushed chrome / x-ray schematic (abstract wireframe) / 2-ink riso misregister / dark chiaroscuro glow
